title: Parameter registry file (WS01-T03), version 0.1.0
description: Serialisation of the contract 02-interfaces.md#parameter-registry. An element of `entries` has exactly the fields of RegistryEntry; PhysioBounds are composed at load time from the entries bound_<signal>_lower and bound_<signal>_upper. Values are unverified until reviewed_by is set (ADR-020). Normative description: docs/formal/03-parameter-registry.md.

registry_version.description: Semantic version of the registry (docs/formal/03-parameter-registry.md section 5). A CarePlan pins this string.

review_status.description: unreviewed: every reviewed_by is null. reviewed: every entry has a reviewer and unset is empty. partially_reviewed: otherwise. The loader checks the consistency of this field with the entries.

window_parameters.description: Names (entries or unset) that are window parameters: offsets or bounds of a temporal operator, look-backs and deadline offsets. The alignment rule (integer multiple of step_ms) is checked for these names only. Not a field of RegistryEntry; see section 2.4 of the document.

entries.description: Parameters that have a value. Each element has exactly the fields of RegistryEntry, in this order: name, value, unit, rationale, source_ref, reviewed_by.

derived.description: Names computed by the loader from a formula over registry names and step_ms (latency bounds). Never free parameters.

unset.description: Names that a template or another consumer needs and that have no value yet. Asking the loader for one raises UnsetParameterError.

overrides.description: Clinician-approved ranges inside which a per-patient value carried in TemplateInstance.param_values may lie. Empty in version 0.1.0 (no per-patient override supported).

unit.description: mmHg, ms, dose, or 1 (dimensionless counts and ranks).

reviewer.description: Clinician identifier, or null until reviewed.

rationale.description: Drug or guideline anchoring, or a text that ends with the string 'illustrative, unverified'.

source_ref.description: Analisi section, guideline or protocol reference. A reference is marked [ref-needed: WS03] until verified (ADR-018).

formula.description: Sum of terms; a term is a registry name or step_ms. Evaluated by the loader grammar, never by eval.

required_by.description: Template ids that need the name; empty for a name needed by another consumer (see note).
